To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the solution of the problem of solar neutrino oscillations can be found by analyzing correlations between the time variations of the flux and the distortion of the spectrum.

(i) the parametric effect is a natural and generic consequence of the neutrino oscillations in the Earth, and (ii) the solution of the neutrino problem in schemes with more than three neutrinos can lead to the complicated distortion of the solar neutrinos spectra.

the parametric effect in oscillations of solar neutrinos can explain the day-night asymmetry of the ν ⊕ flux, the solar neutrino anomaly can be explained in the framework of the MSW mechanism with a small value of the mixing angle, and that time variations of the solar neutrinos are sensitive to the neutrino mass and the mixing angle.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the search for the most promising solutions of the solar neutrinos problem.
the following questions: (i) What are the effects of oscillations of neutrinos in matter?
the following topics: (1) Parametric enhancement of neutrino oscillations in matter with a variable density.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the solar neutrino data are in a very good agreement with the standard solar model and the MSW solutions of the ν ⊭ -problem.
the solar neutrino fluxes are not constant in time, and that the neutrino fluxes have to be measured with high precision in order to understand the solar neutrino puzzle.
the solution of the neutrino problem is still elusive.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the solar neutrino data are consistent with the MSW effect in the 1-10 MeV region of the solar neutrinos.
the ν ⊙-problem can be solved only in a combined approach of neutrino oscillations, solar model and the Earth effects.
the solar neutrino data are consistent with the standard solar model and the standard three neutrino mixing.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the solar neutrino experiments are not only capable to solve the solar neutrino anomaly, but also can shed light on the neutrino mass spectrum, on the properties of matter, and on the physics of the solar interior.
the solar neutrino experiments can provide a unique test for the existence of sterile neutrinos.
the ν ⊙ problem can be resolved in the framework of three neutrino schemes, but the solutions are not necessarily simple.
